system.description: You draw a vast circle in the earth with blood.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the circle holds even if you sleep, until the next day begins.
outcomes.success: A zone of 100' radius becomes invisible and impassable to Undead and Duskborn. It lasts until you leave the circle or fall unconscious.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time and blood are lost.
outcomes.ruin: The circle draws them instead: Undead and Duskborn within a mile know where you are. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
